field.name: id_corp_tax_rate
field.comment: ID corporate income tax rate: 5.3% flat rate (effective 2025, Idaho Code § 63-3025)

field.name: id_apportionment_formula
field.comment: ID uses single-sales factor apportionment (100% sales)

field.name: id_economic_nexus_threshold
field.comment: ID economic nexus gross receipts threshold: $100,000 (primarily for sales tax)

field.name: id_transaction_threshold
field.comment: ID does not use transaction count for corporate income tax nexus

field.name: id_state_additions
field.comment: ID additions to federal taxable income (state income taxes deducted federally, certain expenses, etc.)

field.name: id_state_subtractions
field.comment: ID subtractions from federal taxable income (U.S. government interest, Idaho municipal bond interest, state NOL, etc.)

field.name: id_state_credits
field.comment: ID tax credits (investment tax credit, R&D credit, broadband equipment credit, etc.)

field.name: id_taxable_income
field.comment: ID taxable income after apportionment and modifications

field.name: id_has_nexus
field.comment: Whether corporation has nexus with Idaho
